cases.title: Faulty load-store forwarding with non byte-sized types

target datalayout = "E"

define i8 @src(ptr %p) {
entry:

  %r0 = load i8, ptr %p, align 1
  ret i8 %r0

cases.title: miscompile of vector double-negation + select by InstCombine
[InstCombine] Miscompilation which converts `icmp eq (trunc nsw i64 X), (trunc nsw i32 Y)` into `icmp eq (zext i32 Y), X
cases.ir:
target datalayout = "e-m:e-p270:32:32-p271:32:32-p272:64:64-i64:64-i128:128-f80:128-n8:16:32:64-S128"
target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

define i32 @src() {
entry:
  br label %for.cond

for.cond:                                         ; preds = %if.end, %entry
  %storemerge = phi i32 [ 3, %entry ], [ %dec, %if.end ]
  %h = phi i32 [ 1, %entry ], [ %hres, %if.end ]
  %e = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ -1, %if.end ]
  %tobool.not = icmp eq i32 %storemerge, 0
  br i1 %tobool.not, label %for.end9, label %for.body

for.body:                                         ; preds = %for.cond
  %cmp = icmp eq i32 %h, 5
  %conv1 = zext i1 %cmp to i64
  %conv2 = sext i32 %e to i64
  %cond.i = call i64 @llvm.umax.i64(i64 %conv1, i64 %conv2)
  %conv3 = trunc nsw i64 %cond.i to i16
  %conv4 = trunc nsw i32 %e to i16
  %sub.i = sub i16 %conv3, %conv4
  %tobool6.not = icmp eq i16 %sub.i, 0
  br i1 %tobool6.not, label %if.end, label %if.then

if.then:                                          ; preds = %for.body
  br label %if.end

if.end:                                           ; preds = %if.then, %for.body
  %hres = phi i32 [ 0, %if.then ], [ %h, %for.body ]
  %dec = add nsw i32 %storemerge, -1
  br label %for.cond

for.end9:                                         ; preds = %for.cond
  ret i32 %h
}

define i32 @tgt() {
entry:
  br label %for.cond

for.cond:                                         ; preds = %if.end, %entry
  %storemerge = phi i32 [ 3, %entry ], [ %dec, %if.end ]
  %h = phi i32 [ 1, %entry ], [ %hres, %if.end ]
  %e = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ -1, %if.end ]
  %tobool.not = icmp eq i32 %storemerge, 0
  br i1 %tobool.not, label %for.end9, label %for.body

for.body:                                         ; preds = %for.cond
  %cmp = icmp eq i32 %h, 5
  %conv1 = zext i1 %cmp to i64
  %conv2 = sext i32 %e to i64
  %cond.i = call i64 @llvm.umax.i64(i64 %conv1, i64 %conv2)
  %0 = zext i32 %e to i64
  %tobool6.not = icmp eq i64 %cond.i, %0
  br i1 %tobool6.not, label %if.end, label %if.then

if.then:                                          ; preds = %for.body
  br label %if.end

if.end:                                           ; preds = %if.then, %for.body
  %hres = phi i32 [ 0, %if.then ], [ %h, %for.body ]
  %dec = add nsw i32 %storemerge, -1
  br label %for.cond

for.end9:                                         ; preds = %for.cond
  ret i32 %h
}

cases.title: Miscompile with opt -passes="instcombine"
cases.ir:
%struct.bit = type { i16, i16, i16, i16, i16, i16 }
@bit = global %struct.bit zeroinitializer

define i16 @src() {
entry:
  store %struct.bit {i16 0, i16 0, i16 0, i16 0, i16 2, i16 0}, ptr @bit ; mem @bit is <0x0,0x0,0x0,0x0,0x2,0x0>
  %f0 = getelementptr inbounds %struct.bit, ptr @bit, i32 0, i32 1
  %0 = load <2 x i16>, ptr %f0, align 1                           ; <0x0,0x0>
  %.i09 = extractelement <2 x i16> %0, i64 0                      ; 0x0
  %.i010 = and i16 %.i09, 1                                       ; 0x0
  %.i111 = extractelement <2 x i16> %0, i64 1                     ; 0x0
  %.i112 = and i16 %.i111, 1                                      ; 0x0
  %.upto034 = insertelement <2 x i16> poison, i16 %.i010, i64 0   ; <0x0,p>
  %1 = insertelement <2 x i16> %.upto034, i16 %.i112, i64 1       ; <0x0,0x0>

  %shuff = shufflevector <2 x i16> %1, <2 x i16> poison, <4 x i32> <i32 0, i32 1, i32 poison, i32 poison> ; <0x0,0x0,p,p>
  %sel = select <4 x i1> <i1 true, i1 true, i1 false, i1 false>, <4 x i16> %shuff, <4 x i16> undef        ; <0x0,0x0,u,u>
  %f326 = getelementptr inbounds %struct.bit, ptr @bit, i32 0, i32 4
  %bf.load27 = load i16, ptr %f326, align 1                       ; 0x2
  %extract = extractelement <4 x i16> %sel, i32 2                 ; u
  %bf.clear33 = and i16 %extract, 1                               ; 0x000u only lowest bit is undef
  %bf.set34 = or i16 %bf.clear33, %bf.load27                      ; 0x2 lowest bit is undef
  %bf.ashr39 = ashr i16 %bf.set34, 1                              ; 0x1
  ret i16 %bf.ashr39
}

define i16 @tgt() {
entry:
  store i16 0, ptr @bit, align 2
  store i16 0, ptr getelementptr inbounds (%struct.bit, ptr @bit, i64 0, i32 1), align 2
  store i16 0, ptr getelementptr inbounds (%struct.bit, ptr @bit, i64 0, i32 2), align 2
  store i16 0, ptr getelementptr inbounds (%struct.bit, ptr @bit, i64 0, i32 3), align 2
  store i16 2, ptr getelementptr inbounds (%struct.bit, ptr @bit, i64 0, i32 4), align 2
  store i16 0, ptr getelementptr inbounds (%struct.bit, ptr @bit, i64 0, i32 5), align 2
  ret i16 poison
}

cases.title: Wrong swap between `sdiv` and `extractelement` by InstCombine
[InstCombine] Miscompilation with llvm.assume in unreachable blocks
cases.ir:
define i16 @src(i16 %g, ptr %e, ptr %d) {
entry:
  %0 = load i64, ptr %d, align 8
  %conv = trunc i64 %0 to i16
  %tobool.not.i = icmp eq i16 %g, 0
  br i1 %tobool.not.i, label %i.exit, label %for.cond.preheader.i

for.cond.preheader.i:
  %cmp5.i = icmp ne i16 %g, %conv
  %conv6.i = zext i1 %cmp5.i to i32
  store i32 %conv6.i, ptr %e, align 4
  %cmp7.i = icmp eq i64 %0, 1
  call void @llvm.assume(i1 %cmp7.i)
  unreachable

i.exit:
  ret i16 %conv
}

define i16 @tgt(i16 %g, ptr %e, ptr %d) {
entry:
  %tobool.not.i = icmp eq i16 %g, 0
  br i1 %tobool.not.i, label %i.exit, label %for.cond.preheader.i

for.cond.preheader.i:                             ; preds = %entry
  unreachable

i.exit:                                           ; preds = %entry
  ret i16 1
}

entry:

    br i1 %c, label %ba, label %bb
ba:

bb:

bb:                                               ; preds = %entry
  br label %bt

[InstCombine] `ctlz(X) ^ (BW-1)` -> `cttz(X)` for power-of-two `X` is wrong when the bit width is not a power of two
cases.ir:
define i24 @g(i24 %x) {
  %neg = sub i24 0, %x
  %p = and i24 %x, %neg
  %c = call i24 @llvm.ctlz.i24(i24 %p, i1 true)
  %r = xor i24 %c, 23
  ret i24 %r
}

define i32 @g32(i32 %x) {
  %neg = sub i32 0, %x
  %p = and i32 %x, %neg
  %c = call i32 @llvm.ctlz.i32(i32 %p, i1 true)
  %r = xor i32 %c, 31
  ret i32 %r
}

cases.title: [InstCombine] Folding dependent IVs copies `nnan` onto the new first-iteration value
cases.ir:
define float @f(float %start, i1 %c) {
entry:
  br label %loop

loop:
  %iv = phi float [ %start, %entry ], [ %iv.next, %loop ]
  %iv2 = phi float [ -0.0, %entry ], [ %iv2.next, %loop ]
  %iv2.next = fadd float %iv2, 1.0
  %iv.next = fadd nnan float %start, %iv2.next
  br i1 %c, label %exit, label %loop

exit:
  ret float %iv
}

cases.title: [InstCombine] Bitcast-of-shuffle fold shuffles the already shifted vector again for the next bitcast user
cases.ir:
declare void @use_i32(i32)
declare void @use_float(float)

define void @f(<4 x i16> %x) {
  %s = shufflevector <4 x i16> %x, <4 x i16> poison, <2 x i32> <i32 1, i32 2>
  %b1 = bitcast <2 x i16> %s to i32
  call void @use_i32(i32 %b1)
  %b2 = bitcast <2 x i16> %s to float
  call void @use_float(float %b2)
  ret void
}

cases.title: [InstCombine] extractelement of a bitcast insertelement reads the wrong bits when the lane counts are not multiples
cases.ir:
; <3 x i16> lane 1 is bits 16..31: bits 16..23 of %v[0] and bits 0..7 of %s
define i16 @f(<2 x i24> %v, i24 %s) {
  %ins = insertelement <2 x i24> %v, i24 %s, i64 1
  %bc = bitcast <2 x i24> %ins to <3 x i16>
  %e = extractelement <3 x i16> %bc, i64 1
  ret i16 %e
}

; <3 x i16> lane 2 is bits 32..47: bits 8..23 of %s
define i16 @g(<2 x i24> %v, i24 %s) {
  %ins = insertelement <2 x i24> %v, i24 %s, i64 1
  %bc = bitcast <2 x i24> %ins to <3 x i16>
  %e = extractelement <3 x i16> %bc, i64 2
  ret i16 %e
}

; control: the lane counts divide, folded correctly
define i16 @ok(<2 x i32> %v, i32 %s) {
  %ins = insertelement <2 x i32> %v, i32 %s, i64 1
  %bc = bitcast <2 x i32> %ins to <4 x i16>
  %e = extractelement <4 x i16> %bc, i64 2
  ret i16 %e
}

cases.ir:
define i33 @src(i33 %x) {
  %ctlz = call i33 @llvm.ctlz.i33(i33 %x, i1 true)
  %xor = xor i33 %ctlz, 32
  %ctpop = call i33 @llvm.ctpop.i33(i33 %x)
  %cmp = icmp ugt i33 %ctpop, 1
  %zext = zext i1 %cmp to i33
  %r = add i33 %xor, %zext
  ret i33 %r
}

define i33 @tgt(i33 %x) {
  %1 = add i33 %x, -1
  %2 = call range(i33 0, 34) i33 @llvm.ctlz.i33(i33 %1, i1 false)
  %r = sub nuw nsw i33 33, %2
  ret i33 %r
}

declare i33 @llvm.ctlz.i33(i33, i1 immarg)

declare i33 @llvm.ctpop.i33(i33)

declare void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr, i8, i64, i1)

define i1 @src(ptr %a) {
  call void @llvm.memset.p0.i64(ptr %a, i8 0, i64 16, i1 false)
  %g = getelementptr i8, ptr %a, i64 2305843009213693953
  %v = load i1, ptr %g, align 1
  ret i1 %v

cases.title: [InstCombine] Store of an aggregate built from a vector with non-byte-sized elements is rewritten as a bit-packed vector
cases.ir:
define i32 @f(<2 x i31> %v) {
  %e0 = extractelement <2 x i31> %v, i64 0
  %e1 = extractelement <2 x i31> %v, i64 1
  %a0 = insertvalue [2 x i31] poison, i31 %e0, 0
  %a1 = insertvalue [2 x i31] %a0, i31 %e1, 1
  %p = alloca [2 x i31], align 8
  store [2 x i31] %a1, ptr %p, align 8
  %q = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i64 4
  %r = load i31, ptr %q, align 4
  %z = zext i31 %r to i32
  ret i32 %z
}

define i32 @main() {
  %r = call i32 @f(<2 x i31> <i31 3, i31 3>)
  ret i32 %r
}

cases.ir:
define i32 @main() {
entry:
  %frozen = freeze i32 poison
  br label %loop

loop:
  %i = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ 1, %loop ]
  %previous = phi i32 [ 0, %entry ], [ %selected, %loop ]
  %selected = select i1 true, i32 %frozen, i32 %i
  %done = icmp eq i32 %i, 1
  br i1 %done, label %exit, label %loop

exit:
  %result = xor i32 %previous, %selected
  ret i32 %result
}

cases.title: [InstCombine] Folding masked icmps to RHS exposes poison
[InstCombine] Folding masked icmps to RHS exposes poison
[AggressiveInstCombine] Load merging reads past an object before a non-returning call
cases.ir:
target triple = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"

define void @spin() memory(none) {
entry:
  br label %loop

loop:
  br label %loop
}

define i16 @f(ptr %p) {
  %lo = load i8, ptr %p, align 1
  call void @spin()
  %p1 = getelementptr i8, ptr %p, i64 1
  %hi = load i8, ptr %p1, align 1
  %lo.ext = zext i8 %lo to i16
  %hi.ext = zext i8 %hi to i16
  %hi.shl = shl i16 %hi.ext, 8
  %r = or i16 %lo.ext, %hi.shl
  ret i16 %r
}

define i32 @main() {
  %obj = alloca i8, align 1
  store i8 7, ptr %obj, align 1
  %r = call i16 @f(ptr %obj)
  %r.ext = zext i16 %r to i32
  ret i32 %r.ext
}
